description: This bar chart illustrates the scores achieved by three different models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across three benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmark name, labeled “Benchmark,” with categories listed in the order MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” displays a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  Three bars are presented for each benchmark, representing the score for each model; SRPO-7B is represented by a dark blue bar, GRPO-7B by a medium blue bar, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B by a light blue bar. For MathVista, the SRPO-7B bar reaches approximately 75.8, GRPO-7B reaches 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B reaches 68.2.  For MathVerse, the corresponding values are 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3, respectively. Finally, for Physics, the scores are 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with each model’s score displayed side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not indicate any specific sorting order.
